scope: Three-batch integration: seven configurable whole-flow setups and typed cross-component links; actual DOM operations, snapshots, identity, drafts, failures, stale requests and composition. No production service or full browser certification.

checks.name: All seven multi-component flow configurations mount, validate declared link types and retain caller data
Roster-to-audience excludes suspended members without treating locked records as ineligible students
Confirmed audience, curriculum and assignment snapshots join one task without editing its course basis
Publishing preserves all linked snapshots and later roster transfers cannot rewrite them
Task publication rejects out-of-assignment audiences and ended teaching relations
Unconfirmed or invalid curriculum edits do not propagate as an authoritative task snapshot
Goal archive updates plan references without deleting or silently changing the plan
Teaching tasks and learning resources merge by stable IDs without dropping either directory
Completing a teaching task unlocks explicit growth-task evidence entry but never completes the plan automatically
Learning position and explicit completion remain different when linked to growth tasks
Creating a job application appends one pinned draft, not a fabricated external submission
Job creation failure does not append a downstream application or erase a modal draft
Job closure or revision changes block new submission while preserving previously pinned application snapshots
Source resource withdrawal invalidates new evidence submissions but preserves old citation snapshots
Evidence approval makes actual approved versions available to a zero-valued indicator
Withdrawing evidence blocks resubmission but never rewrites an indicator submission snapshot
Reference refresh preserves real File objects and draft text during source invalidation
Equipment state propagates to repair references and active repairs block new inventory allocations
Closing a repair removes its allocation block without silently restoring a maintained device
Bidirectional operations links stabilize without infinite feedback or duplicate records
Paper synchronization strips unreleased answers and refuses to overwrite student answer drafts automatically
Submitted answer snapshots and readonly or forbidden answer panes cannot be replaced, even by forced synchronization
A real rubric-confirmed review stages its computed score and source version into one grade draft
Rejected grading does not leak an unconfirmed score to grade records
Confirmed zero grades remain zero and conflicting grade drafts require explicit overwrite
Published grades cannot be overwritten by later reviews and retain source snapshots
Different grading maxima require an explicit configured scale instead of silent conversion
Reference updates preserve an in-progress composition and validate the committed text afterward
Cross-identity personal links and forbidden sources cannot transfer their data
Directory updates and business data replacement invalidate stale consumer request IDs without committing them
Malformed link kinds, duplicate connection IDs and record imports cannot partially overwrite working data
Disconnecting a bridge stops later source confirmations and leaves receivers untouched
The real integration laboratory mounts all editable flows without browser exceptions
Open confirmation dialogs revalidate changed source and evidence directories before acknowledging
Checkout confirmation rechecks newly linked repair blocks before recording handover
Task publish confirmation rechecks changed teaching relations before submitting
Conflicting merged directories roll back contributions and allow the healthy source to synchronize again
Individually selected students must also belong to the linked teaching assignment
Growth completion preserves evidence input when a linked task changes during the dialog
Indicator snapshots use references at confirmation and review rejects changed immutable evidence versions
